verdict.rationale: Runloop's documented browser-agent path drives an externally hosted browser (Browserbase or Kernel) from the devbox, and the docs state that "no Chromium ever runs in the devbox." So the browser does not run inside the sandbox as the story asks. Custom Dockerfile blueprints and port tunnels suggest you could install and expose your own headless browser, but this is only implied, never documented. Missing for 10: documented headless browser running inside the devbox, any full desktop/GUI environment (VNC or remote display), a prebuilt browser or desktop blueprint, and hands-on corroboration.
